name: DUMBBELL V-UP
introduce: Lie on your back with your legs extended and squeezed together. Hold a dumbbell in your hands and extend your arms overhead. \n\nRaise your upper body and legs, using your feet to meet your hands at the centerline of your body. Return and repeat.

tips.text: Please try to keep your legs straight.
Exhale on the way up, and inhale on the way down.
This is a good exercise for your upper and lower abs.
